title: Coal power purchase agreements; prohibited.
bodyText:
Beginning after June 30, 2020, the public utilities commission shall not approve:

(1) Any new or renewed power purchase agreement that proposes to burn or consume coal to generate electricity; or

(2) A modification of a coal power purchase agreement that proposes to extend the term or increase the amount of generation that is allowed to be produced under the existing agreement.
crossReferences: Use of coal for electricity generation, see §342B-36.

[§269-48]  Coal power purchase agreements; prohibited.  Beginning after June 30, 2020, the public utilities commission shall not approve:

     (1)  Any new or renewed power purchase agreement that proposes to burn or consume coal to generate electricity; or

     (2)  A modification of a coal power purchase agreement that proposes to extend the term or increase the amount of generation that is allowed to be produced under the existing agreement. [L 2020, c 23, §2]
